body.x: Techwin System Co. Ltd. introduced measurement and control equipment/ electric panel/ water & sewage solutions by participating at ‘2017 Korea Electronics Show(KES)’ which is hosted at Samsung-dong Coex for 4 days from 17th of October(Tues) to 20th(Fri).

Techwin System Co. Ltd. is a company established on the basis of wired and wireless communication and control technology development. This company is leading new technology development with aggressive investment towards supervisory control and fields of application on basis of various base stations, optical communication equipment, NMS technology.

In this exhibition, it introduced measurement and control equipment/ electric panel/ water & sewage solutions. Director of Techwin System Co. Ltd., Jae-hoon Hong said that Techwin System Co. Ltd.’s products are stable and are convenient to maintain and manage” and that “various interface enhances the efficiency of operation.”

Meanwhile, KES 2017, hosted by Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Energy and sponsored by KEA (Korea Electronics Association), is an international show where lots of potential buyers, governments, group officials participate, providing a good place to experience world first products like mobile phone, semiconductor, display, and next generation convergence solutions like industrial convergence, IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education and e health.
